segments.name: Jack in the Box
products: breakfast sandwiches with freshly cracked eggs
segments.description: Operates and franchises one of the nation's largest hamburger chains, primarily in the western and southern United States.
segments.evidence: Jack in the Box restaurants offer a broad selection of distinctive products including classic burgers like its Jumbo Jack ® and innovative product lines such as the Buttery Jack ® and Smash Jack ® burgers.

segments.name: Del Taco
segments.description: Operates and franchises a Mexican-American quick service restaurant chain serving Mexican and American favorites prepared fresh.
segments.evidence: Del Taco offers a unique variety of both Mexican and American favorites such as burritos and fries, prepared fresh in every restaurant's kitchen with the value and convenience of a drive-thru.

revenueModel.text: The company earns retail sales at company-operated restaurants and rental revenue, royalties, advertising, and franchise and other fees from franchise-operated restaurants.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive revenue from retail sales at Jack in the Box and Del Taco company-operated restaurants and rental revenue, royalties, advertising, and franchise and other fees from franchise-operated restaurants.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company entered into an agreement to sell Del Taco Holdings Inc. to Yadav Enterprises, Inc.
changes.evidence: On October 15, 2025, the Company entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement (the "Purchase Agreement") with Yadav Enterprises, Inc., a California corporation ("Buyer") and Anil Yadav ("Buyer Guarantor") to sell to Buyer all of the issued and outstanding equity interests of Del Taco Holdings Inc.
